semantic_seed.ace_symptom: ACE can record hashes and evidence lineage, but no hardware-attestation verifier or payload-bound proof exists.
semantic_seed.counterexample_question: Can a valid environment attestation be replayed for a different L2 snapshot, stale file, or media staging payload when the payload hash and nonce are not cryptographically bound?
semantic_seed.extracted_mechanism: Remote attestation is evidence about a measured execution environment; any use for data lineage must bind a verifier result to the exact payload hash and freshness challenge.
semantic_seed.next_verification: Compare public attestation claim schemas with a fixture-only envelope containing verifier identity, measurement, nonce, expiry, signature status, and bound payload hash; classify all absent hardware as UNVERIFIED.
semantic_seed.transfer_hypothesis: A research-only attestation envelope can make absence, expiry, invalidity, and unverifiability explicit without changing Admission or claiming hardware-backed data provenance.
